jobs.description: Compact and expire every table of the lakehouse contract artifact under the snapshot retention of root ADR-0237 (30 days, 12 month ends, every year end), the least recently maintained first, in one Spark run (infra/lakehouse/spark/jobs/lakehouse_maintenance.py --all-tables, root ADR-0238). It starts no table after the maintenance contract's deadline; a table it does not reach is first at the next run. Compaction takes only the small files writes left since the last compaction (a table under the contract's trigger is skipped, and Iceberg leaves files already near the target alone); expiry and the file counts read metadata only (2026-10-29: 48 tables, compaction ran in three of them and read 15, 278 and 0 files). Its volume is therefore what the writers wrote: on 2026-10-26 it rewrote all of gold.parcel_panel because a copy-on-write MERGE had just rewritten all of it (root ADR-0344). Expiry keeps every snapshot a tag names; a reader that needs one older than 30 days pins it with its own tag (snapshot_expiry.reader_pins, root ADR-0338), and the run refuses a table where a bake pin or served state the host holds would expire. It changes no rows, so it starts nothing downstream.

expected_outcome.no_change_bound_reason: An operation, not a data producer: `unchanged` is its normal outcome. That it keeps finishing is the done bound.
